test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Serene
solution: The correct answer is **Agitated****.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Serene- **is an adjective that describes a state of calmness, tranquility, and peace (शांतिपूर्ण) • E.g.- Walking through the tranquil garden, I felt a sense of serenity wash over me, leaving behind all my worries. • The most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word is **Agitated**. • Agitated means **feeling or appearing troubled or nervous. (**परेशान या घबराया हुआ **)** • **For Example - **There's no point getting **agitated**. • Thus, the correct answer is** **Option 4.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Unperturbed **means **not perturbed or concerned. (**बाहरी कारकों या घटनाओं से अप्रभावित, शांत और अप्रभावित होने की अवस्था**)** • **Pleased **means **feeling or showing pleasure and satisfaction, especially at an event or a situation. (**विशेष रूप से किसी घटना या स्थिति में खुशी और संतुष्टि महसूस करना या दिखाना।**)** • **Composed **means **having one's feelings and expression under control. (**किसी की भावनाओं और अभिव्यक्ति को नियंत्रण में रखना**)** 3c:T6f6, The erroneous part is:** lay between**.
